messages:
Maya (Finance): Alert: international renewal for invoice 9129 declined by issuer with AVS/3DS mismatch, customer in EU billing USD.
Sam (Payments): Decline code and acquirer notes?
Maya (Finance): gateway: code=N92; acquirer_msg=refer_to_issuer; 3ds_status=not_present; avs=fail
Eli (Support): Customer says card is corporate card and treasury prefers wire (SEPA) to avoid FX and tokenization issues.
Nora (Accounting): SEPA fine. Invoice ~€14,700 equivalent. Any KYC/beneficiary requirements?
Sam (Payments): For SEPA we need IBAN + remittance ref. Pause auto-retries for cross-border invoices to avoid extra declines.
payments-bot: scheduled reminder: followup in 24h for invoice 9129
Maya (Finance): Agree wire preferred. Nora send SEPA instructions and request bank confirmation and PO#. Also mark invoice to stop gateway retries.
Nora (Accounting): Drafted & sent: Bank: EuroTrust Bank; IBAN: DE44 5001 0517 5407 3249 31; BIC: ETDEFFXXX; Beneficiary: Redwood Inference GmbH; Ref: inv 9129 - Acme EU. Requested bank confirmation.
Eli (Support): Customer ack'd, treasury initiating SEPA transfer and will email proof when done.
Sam (Payments): Once we get proof I'll mark paid, reconcile FX, and disable retry schedule. Also file a routing ticket for EU card issuers.
Maya (Finance): Action: KB on cross-border declines and preferred wire flow; run acquirer routing audit for EU-issued BINs. Closing loop when payment clears.
Eli (Support): Noted. Will update on confirmation. :white_check_mark:
